subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth number in the same way as the firstn umber is related to the second number and third number is related to fourth number.

8432 ∶ 4382 ∶∶ 2496 ∶ 4926 ∶∶ ? ∶ 2174
solution:
The logic followed here is :

 
• **First digit -** Shits to the third position from the left.
 
• **Second digit -** Shits to the first position from the left.
 
• **Third digit -** Shits to the second position from the left.
 
• **Fourth digit - **Remains at the same position.

So,

 
• 8432 ∶ 4382

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d62f84de174b769960dc0d23de7dfa19ff0bd919de60e6f5e02ea5f990925ed.png] 

 
• 2496 ∶ 4926

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0daac09058f6a306fc270da3231b664d271f4f7e981fda0f31c05b5cc098c68a.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ? ∶ 2174

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe0f574fd1096dd5e17f10105b0f30dd700e93d7a8d6cd3ccb474b49610aa203.png] ​

Hence, **"7214"** is the correct answer.
